'''Patanjali Foods''', formerly known as '''Ruchi Soya Industries Ltd''', is an Indian [[Multinational corporation|multinational]] [[fast-moving consumer goods]] company specialized in the [[food industry]], part of the [[Patanjali Ayurved]]. It is headquartered in [[Indore]], India.

Patanjali Foods is a listed company on [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] and [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] with ticker symbol "PATANJALI".<ref>{{cite web |title=Patanjali Foods Share Price Today, Patanjali Foods Stock Price Live NSE/BSE, Share Price Insights |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/patanjali-foods-ltd/stocks/companyid-13169.cms |website=The Economic Times |language=en}}</ref>

== History ==
Ruchi Soya Industries Limited was founded in 1986 by Dinesh Sahara, to manufacture [[soybean]] [[edible oil]].<ref>{{cite news |title=Ruchi Soya inks MOU with Arunachal Pradesh government |url=https://indianexpress.com/article/business/companies/ruchi-soya-inks-mou-with-arunachal-pradesh-government-3075617/ |work=[[The Indian Express]] |date=October 10, 2016}}</ref>

In January 2010, the company acquired a 50 percent stake in Gemini Edibles and Fats India for {{INR}}45 [[crore]],<ref>{{cite news |title=Ruchi Soya buys 50 pc in Gemini for Rs 45 crore |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/ruchi-soya-buys-50-pc-in-gemini-for-rs-45-crore/articleshow/5418074.cms |work=[[The Economic Times]] |date=January 7, 2010}}</ref> until the whole company was purchased by the Widjaja family of Indonesia in 2014.<ref name=B>{{cite news |last1=Verma |first1=Anuradha |title=Widjaja Family Promoted Golden Agri Buying 75% Stake In Ruchi Soya Arm For $25.6M |url=https://www.vccircle.com/widjaja-family-promoted-golden-agri-buying-75-stake-ruchi-soya-arm-256m |publisher=[[VCCircle]] |date=November 13, 2014}}</ref>

In December 2017, Ruchi Soya Industries entered into insolvency with a total debt of about ₹12,000 crore.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bloombergquint.com/insolvency/ruchi-soyas-run-of-bad-luck-and-a-self-inflicted-injury|title=Ruchi Soya's Run Of Bad Luck And A Self-Inflicted Injury|website=BloombergQuint|date=21 June 2018 |language=en|access-date=2020-04-21}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.firstpost.com/business/ruchi-soyas-lenders-to-meet-today-to-consider-highest-bidder-adani-wilmars-rs-6000-cr-bid-4863691.html|title=Ruchi Soya's lenders to meet today to consider highest bidder Adani Wilmar's Rs 6,000 cr bid|website=Firstpost|date=August 2018 |access-date=2020-04-21}}</ref> In December 2019, [[Patanjali Ayurved]] acquired the bankrupt Ruchi Soya for {{INR}}4,350 crore.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2019-12-18|title=Patanjali Ayurved completes acquisition of bankrupt Ruchi Soya for ₹4,350 cr|url=https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/patanjali-ayurved-completes-acquisition-of-bankrupt-ruchi-soya-for-rs-4-350-crore-11576684912487.html|access-date=2020-07-13|website=Livemint|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |title=Ruchi Soya Industries Ltd now becomes Patanjali Foods Ltd |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/ruchi-soya-industries-ltd-now-becomes-patanjali-foods-ltd/articleshow/92520997.cms?from=mdr |work=[[The Economic Times]] |date=Jun 28, 2022}}</ref>

In June 2021, Ruchi Soya acquired the biscuits and noodles business of Patanjali Ayurved for {{INR}}60 crore.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Chakraborty |first1=Chiranjivi |title=Ruchi Soya acquires biscuits, noodles business of Patanjali ahead of FPO |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/ruchi-soya-acquires-biscuits-noodles-business-of-patanjali-ahead-of-fpo/articleshow/83541539.cms |work=[[The Economic Times]] |date=Jun 15, 2021}}</ref> It acquired the food business of Patanjali Ayurved for around {{INR}}690 crore in May 2022.<ref>{{cite news |last1=D'Souza |first1=Sharleen |title=Ruchi Soya acquires Patanjali Ayurved's food business for Rs 690 crore |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/ruchi-soya-to-acquire-patanjali-s-food-retail-business-for-rs-690-crore-122051800758_1.html |work=[[Business Standard]] |date=May 19, 2022}}</ref> Ruchi Soya changed its name to Patanjali Foods in June 2022.<ref name=renamed>{{cite news |title=Ruchi Soya Industries renamed Patanjali Foods with effect from June 24 |url=https://www.business-standard.com/article/companies/ruchi-soya-industries-renamed-patanjali-foods-with-effect-from-june-24-122062800707_1.html |access-date=7 February 2023 |work=Business Standard |date=28 June 2022 |language=en}}</ref>

In 2023, [[SEBI]] froze promoters shares for failing to allow the minimum public shareholding in listed companies at 25%.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Sethuraman |first1=Nallur |last2=Upadhyay |first2=Jayshree |title=India's Patanjali Foods falls after stock exchanges freeze promoters' shares |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/india/indias-patanjali-foods-falls-after-stock-exchanges-freeze-promoters-shares-2023-03-16/ |access-date=18 March 2023 |publisher=[[Reuters]] |date=16 March 2023 |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{cite news |last1=Bhalla |first1=Akriti |title=Ramdev's Patanjali Foods has lost its mojo |url=https://themorningcontext.com/business/ramdevs-patanjali-foods-has-lost-its-mojo |access-date=18 March 2023 |work=[[The Morning Context]] |date=14 March 2023}}</ref>

In 2025, a prohibition order on the sale of Patanjali Organic Wild Honey was revoked.<ref>{{cite web |title=Patanjali Foods says prohibition on Patanjali Organic Wild Honey revoked |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/cons-products/food/patanjali-foods-says-prohibition-on-patanjali-organic-wild-honey-revoked/articleshow/122358690.cms |website=The Economic Times |date=10 July 2025}}</ref>

In September 2025, Patanjali Foods signed a MoU with [[Ministry of Food Processing Industries]], [[Government of India]] and announced {{INR}}1000 crore investment in food processing across [[Uttarakhand]], [[Uttar Pradesh]], [[Madhya Pradesh]], [[Maharashtra]], [[Karnataka]] and [[Odisha]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Patanjali Foods commits Rs 1,000 crore investments in food processing to create 7,000 jobs |url=https://www.zeebiz.com/companies/news-patanjali-foods-says-rs-1000-crore-planned-investments-to-create-7000-jobs-in-food-processing-signs-pact-with-mofpi-379703 |website=Zee Business |language=en}}</ref>

In November 2025, Patanjali Foods collaborated with [[Indian Council of Agricultural Research]] for scientific innovation, quality planting material, and enhanced support for citrus growers.<ref>{{cite web |title=ICAR-CCRI and Patanjali Foods Limited Sign MoA to Strengthen India’s Citrus Value Chain {{!}} ICAR |url=https://www.icar.org.in/en/icar-ccri-and-patanjali-foods-limited-sign-moa-strengthen-indias-citrus-value-chain |website=Icar.org.in}}</ref>
